review_notes: I read the whole file. The new declarations are factorRadiusLevel, actualFactorStops, factorSwitchList and their lemmas. I also grepped for their uses in the Multipoint directory. factorRadiusLevel is a three-point piecewise level, 0 ↦ u₀, 1 ↦ midpoint, 2 ↦ u₂. It is used by norm_num unfolding in MultipointCompletionExhaustion and MultipointActualBudget, and Mathlib has no matching named concept. factorSwitchList is a list of stopping-time functions, namely the zero function followed by the images of ρ over a Finset's toList. Its membership and forall lemmas are used in MultipointActualExpectation. It is a thin local helper, and I found no specific Mathlib concept it duplicates. The other declarations are problem-specific theorems about the SLE stopping times, with no competing Mathlib definition. I did not search Mathlib exhaustively for list-of-stopping-times utilities. I found no case for consolidation, so I abstain.
